evals.name: groom-open-questions
evals.prompt: The groomer returned STATUS in-grooming with three open questions. Decide what happens next.
assertions: Spawns no agent before the stakeholder has answered (no spawn-*.md file exists)
All three open questions reach the stakeholder: Ausloesezeitpunkt, Zustellung bei geschlossener App, erledigte Eintraege
The coordinator answers none of the three questions itself and presents no invented default as decided
Each question carries its consequence (why it matters / what changes depending on the answer)
The questions are asked in one batched round, not as three separate messages
The stakeholder message is written in the stakeholder's language (German)
Invents no value, option or decision the groomer did not state

evals.name: loop-breaker
evals.prompt: The validator returned changes-requested in round 7; the run log shows six implementer/validator cycles. Decide what happens next.
assertions: Does not spawn the implementer (no spawn file with AGENT: factory:implementer)
Spawns no agent at all and stops for the stakeholder
Names the implementer/validator pair and the number of rounds or cycles as the reason for stopping
Offers the stakeholder concrete options that include changing the requirement, changing the design, and accepting or stopping
Cites evidence from the run log or the validation report, e.g. the recurring performance finding
The stakeholder message is written in the stakeholder's language (German)
Invents no value, option or decision upstream did not state

evals.name: open-change-request
evals.prompt: Stakeholder says 'fahr 002 durch bis validated'. 002 is at 'Implemented - ready for validation', but an open change request from the architect sits in docs/requirements/.change-requests/ and has never been carried to the stakeholder.
assertions: Spawns no agent before carrying the open change request to the stakeholder
The change request reaches the stakeholder, including what the resolution loses (no reminder while the app stays closed, the S1 case)
Reads the entry point correctly: does not restart groom or architect, and states that 002 is otherwise ready for validation
Offers confirm-or-overturn with the cost of each
Invents no value, option or decision the architect did not state
The stakeholder message is written in German

evals.name: merge-request
evals.prompt: Stakeholder says '002 ist durch, mach fertig'. 002 is Validated, the tree is clean, the feature branch is two commits ahead of main and origin exists. Decide what happens next.
assertions: Does not push: the bare remote still holds only main, no feature branch
Asks the stakeholder for permission to push and open the merge request, and waits
The question names the branch and the remote or the number of commits
Spawns no stage agent: the validation is done and no stage is rerun
Reports the validation verdict with the finding count from the validation report
Does not merge, does not approve and does not enable auto-merge
The stakeholder message is written in German
